messages:
Evan: FYI — enterprise PM reported a common request: give a tenant admin 'view billing' across all projects but explicitly block 'deploy'. How do we model that in the console without exploding the number of roles? :thinking:

Priya: We talked about this last week. My thinking: keep a small set of curated base roles (Viewer / Operator / Admin) and then allow additive 'allow' masks at scoped resources (project, route-group). UX: show scope pills and an "Overrides" section. We avoid creating a unique role per combo.

Sam: Big caveat: if we let users toggle per-route permissions we get combinatorial explosion if customers have hundreds of routes. Need macro-scopes (env: prod/staging) + tag-based groups (eg: routes tagged billing/*). Also require an API for bulk grants.

Jules: Telemetry requirement: every grant/revoke needs an audit entry with who, when, and the effective diff of policies. For console UX, we should surface the last grant action inline on the role card and provide a timeline drilldown.

Evan: Entitlements inheritance concerns me. Tenant-level grants should cascade to projects by default, but we need a clear override model. Silent inheritance will confuse support.

Priya: Proposed UX compromise: inheritance is on by default but visible — show an "Inherited from tenant" badge and make overrides explicit. Add a read-only breadcrumb like: Tenant > Project > Route so users can trace origin.

Sam: From the auth service side: current model stores policies as sets of route IDs. To support groups we should accept logical selectors (tags, regex) and expand them to IDs asynchronously. That lets lookup remain a cache-compatible set. Also optimize checks using route-group IDs instead of long lists.

Jules: Edge case: delegation to third-parties. We need time-limited grants and optional conditions (MFA required for grant). Console should have a "Grant duration" dropdown (1d,7d,30d,custom) and show expiration warnings. Backend needs TTL on grants.

Evan: For the public API we should expose a PATCH endpoint for role updates. Example payload I sketched:

```json
{
  "role_id": "role-operator",
  "scopes": [
    {"type": "project", "id": "proj-123", "allow": ["view","metrics"], "deny": ["deploy"]},
    {"type": "route_tag", "tag": "billing", "allow": ["view"]}
  ],
  "inherit": true,
  "expires_at": null
}
```

Priya: That looks good. For the console UI we should hide the raw JSON behind a guided flow: 1) pick role template, 2) pick scopes (checkbox tree + tag autocomplete), 3) set overrides & expiry, 4) review diff.

Sam: Performance note — auth check path must remain O(1) or O(log n). Implement a cached policy hash per principal that we invalidate on role changes. Also precompute effective grants for frequently used principals (service accounts).

Jules: Telemetry fields to add to audit log: actor_id, grant_source (console/api), scope_selector (original selector string), expanded_ids_count, diff_snapshot_id. That will make rollbacks and forensic easy.

Evan: Decision/next steps: Priya to prototype the console flow mock (deadline: Tue), Sam to update auth design to support selectors and TTLs, Jules to spec audit/telemetry schema, I will draft the API contract and add examples. We'll sync next Tue in this thread. :white_check_mark:
